Question:
Two lines intersect, and \(\angle 1=50^\circ\). What is the measure of the vertical angle of \(\angle 1\)? (Unit: degrees; enter only the numerical value.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_063_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: The adjacent supplementary angle of \(\angle 1\) is \(130^\circ\). Its vertical angle is the adjacent supplementary angle of this \(130^\circ\) angle, so it is \(180^\circ-130^\circ=50^\circ\). Thus, vertical angles are equal.
